text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Continent(x) ::: x is a continent.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.
LocatedInTransitive(x, y) ::: place x is located in place y, assuming transitivity.

Premises:
BarutinCove ::: Barutin Cove
Settlement(Barutin, "Barutin")
LocatedOn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island
SnowIsland, GreenwichIsland, DeceptionIsland ::: are located in the South Shetland Islands
Antarctica ::: is located on the South Shetland Islands
∀A ∀B ∀C (LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C) → LocatedIn(A, C)) ::: Transitive property of location

Conclusion:
∀x (NamedAfter(x, "Antarctica") → ∀y (Island(y) → NamedAfter(x, y))) ::: Barutin Cove is named after all islands in Antarctica
